 Tulsa’s Tre Lamb looks to build on bowl eligibility as Golden Hurricane prepare for Charlotte
 After securing Tulsa’s first bowl eligibility since 2021, Lamb discusses the program’s turnaround, the importance of finishing strong and Saturday’s home finale.
 November 16, 2026 10:01 PM 1 min read 
 Copy 
 Link copied 
 Email
 Print
 Tulsa football is bowl eligible for the first time since 2021, but head coach Tre Lamb says the Golden Hurricane still have plenty to accomplish.
 Coming off a 38-21 win over Florida Atlantic, Tulsa (6-4) returns home Saturday to face Charlotte in its final home game of the season.
 Lamb reflected on the emotions of reaching six wins, the seniors who stayed with the program through a coaching change and the opportunity to reach eight victories, something Tulsa has accomplished just once in the past 14 years.
 The Golden Hurricane coach also discussed the challenge of keeping his team focused after back-to-back conference wins, the impact of Jimmy Calloway’s return and the improvement of Tulsa’s defensive line.
 **Watch the full news conference above as Lamb previews Charlotte and discusses what’s next for the Golden Hurricane.**
